summary: MaxsMaking Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its two major shareholders, ThriveNova Inc. and OptimaForge Inc., agreed to redesignate an aggregate of 7,425,000 B shares into an equal number of A shares, both with par value $0.01. The redesignation was approved by the board on August 25, 2026. Following the transaction, there are 16,625,000 A shares outstanding and no B shares. The A shares were issued in reliance on Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. This is a routine share-class conversion, not a special situation; no price, premium, or strategic deal terms are involved.
